Featured Projects

My most technically significant work, built before and beside university.

Street Bot

Intelligent Vehicle Safety & Collision Prevention System

A vehicle-safety robot I built before university. It measures the distance to a vehicle or object ahead and responds in stages: warning, gradual slowing, and braking only at a critical distance.

Honorable Mention — 3rd Bangladesh Robot Olympiad Participant — 23rd Bangladesh Robot Olympiad

A prototype robotics project, not a production-ready or certified automotive braking system.

Overview

Measures the distance to a vehicle or object ahead and responds progressively at different safety thresholds. It was intended to run on solar energy.

Problem / Motivation

A sudden full-force brake can make a vehicle lose balance or overturn. The goal was a progressive mechanism instead of abrupt emergency braking.

Engineering Approach

Distance thresholds trigger escalating responses: no warning, beep, stronger alarm, gradual deceleration, then a stop at about 5 m or less. It only reduces existing speed.

Accident Notification

After an accident, the system can send a notification to the owner's phone.

Safety Considerations

Gradual speed reduction instead of maximum braking force lowers the risk of losing balance or overturning.

My Contribution & Recognition

I developed this robot myself before university. It earned an Honorable Mention at the 3rd Bangladesh Robot Olympiad, and I later took part in the 23rd.

Project photos coming soon

Automatic Water Tank Safety Controller

Contactless IoT Water Level & Pump Safety System

A household water-pump controller built around safety. A waterproof ultrasonic sensor measures the water level from above, so no sensing wires or contacts sit in the water.

Contactless sensing, automatic pump control, IoT monitoring. Designed to reduce electrical exposure to the water, not claimed to be completely risk-free.

Overview

Automatically controls a household water pump from the tank level. Pump automation itself isn't the innovation; the main focus is safety.

Problem / Motivation

Common sensors put conductors or switches in direct contact with the water, a potential electrical hazard if something goes wrong. I wanted a design with no direct electrical contact.

Engineering Approach

A waterproof ultrasonic sensor on the top cover measures the distance to the water surface. That drives the pump and can be monitored online via IoT.

My Contribution

I developed this project myself, focusing on contactless sensing and electrical safety rather than pump automation alone.

Early Projects & Experiments

Where it started: small builds that introduced me to sensors, Arduino, and embedded systems.

Early Making & Crafting

Where it began

Before working with electronics and robotics, I started by building simple physical models and hands-on creations, including cardboard mechanical models such as an excavator. These early experiments helped develop my interest in building, experimenting, and turning ideas into physical prototypes.

Laser Light Security

Class 7–10 · Early project

A laser light on one side and an LDR sensor on the opposite side. The beam continuously reached the LDR; if an object or person passed between them, the beam was interrupted, the system detected it, and it could trigger an alarm or warning. One of my early experiments with sensors, light detection, simple automation, and security systems.

Laser light LDR sensor Alarm / warning

Arduino Ultrasonic Sensing

Around Class 7 · Learning project

An ultrasonic/sonar sensor connected to an Arduino and a laptop. When a person or object passed in front of the sensor, the system detected it, displayed/blinked an indicator, and showed the object's distance. Built to understand ultrasonic sensing, distance measurement, Arduino programming, and real-time sensor data.

Arduino Ultrasonic sonar Laptop connection

Accident Detection Alert

Early embedded-systems prototype

An early prototype that detected whether a vehicle had been in an accident or moved into an abnormal orientation. An auxiliary/accelerometer-type sensor read how far the vehicle had tilted from its normal orientation; on an abnormal condition such as overturning, the system could send an SMS to a previously saved phone number.

Accelerometer Tilt sensing SMS alert
